misc_music_deezer_cut: This Deezer link looks cut short.
misc_music_deezer_kinds: Deezer links to a track, album or playlist can play on the wall.
misc_music_deezer_short: Short Deezer links cannot be read here: open it, then copy the full deezer.com link.
misc_music_not_link: That is not a link. Paste a Spotify, Deezer or YouTube link: a track, album, playlist, episode or video.
misc_music_spotify_cut: This Spotify link looks cut short.
misc_music_spotify_kinds: Spotify links to a track, album, playlist or episode can play on the wall.
misc_music_spotify_short: Short Spotify links cannot be read here: open it, then copy the full open.spotify.com link.
misc_music_unsupported: Paste a Spotify, Deezer or YouTube link: a track, album, playlist, episode or video.
misc_music_youtube_cut: This YouTube link looks cut short.
misc_music_youtube_empty: This YouTube link has no video or playlist in it.
misc_music_youtube_page: Paste the link of a YouTube video or playlist, not of a channel or a page.
misc_speaker_download_failed: The Spotify player could not be downloaded (sdk.scdn.co unreachable).
misc_speaker_fix_auth: Trying again by itself. If it keeps failing, reconnect Spotify in Settings → Wall music.
misc_speaker_fix_insecure: Spotify only plays in a secure page: open DumbMonit over HTTPS (a reverse proxy), or as http://localhost on the display itself.
misc_speaker_fix_no_drm: Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer plugged into the TV (Firefox: allow “Play DRM-controlled content”; Chromium on a Raspberry Pi: install Widevine, the libwidevinecdm0 package). Most smart-TV and kiosk browsers cannot. Otherwise play from the TV’s own Spotify app or a Chromecast: the wall still shows what plays.
misc_speaker_fix_premium: Connect a Premium account in Settings → Wall music. Now playing still shows what plays on your other devices.
misc_speaker_fix_reconnect: An admin can connect Spotify again in Settings → Wall music.
misc_speaker_not_accepted: Spotify did not accept this display as a speaker.
misc_speaker_not_ready: This display is not ready as a speaker yet.
misc_speaker_not_started: The Spotify player did not start.
misc_speaker_playback_error: Spotify could not play this track ({message}).
misc_speaker_problem_init: This browser cannot play Spotify: its DRM (Widevine) did not start{detail}.
misc_speaker_problem_premium: Spotify Premium is required for the wall to be a speaker.
misc_speaker_reason_insecure: This display opened DumbMonit over plain HTTP.
misc_speaker_reason_no_drm: This browser cannot play Spotify: it has no DRM module (Widevine).
misc_speaker_reason_no_eme: This browser cannot play Spotify: it has no Encrypted Media Extensions (DRM).
settings_music_admin_only: An admin can connect a Spotify account here.
settings_music_connect_intro: The wall becomes a speaker named {name}: in the Spotify app on your phone, open Devices and pick it, the sound comes out of the display. The wall also shows what plays on the account wherever it plays — the TV's app, a cast speaker, your laptop.
settings_music_description: Start music from your phone and hear it on the wall display, or send it a Spotify, Deezer or YouTube link.
settings_music_err_client_id: Paste the Client ID from your app’s page in the Spotify Developer Dashboard (32 letters and digits).
settings_music_expired: Spotify ended the connection. Connect again below: the Client ID is kept.
settings_music_expired_reason: Spotify ended the connection ({reason}). Connect again below: the Client ID is kept.
settings_music_link_heading: Play a link on the walls
settings_music_link_intro: Without Premium, or for Deezer and YouTube — which have no Connect-style remote on the web — send a link from any screen, your phone included: every wall plays it in the service's own player. A browser not signed in to Spotify or Deezer on the wall plays 30-second previews.
settings_music_link_label: Link to play on the walls
settings_music_load_error: Could not load the music settings
settings_music_missing: This server does not offer wall music yet: update DumbMonit.
settings_music_missing_scopes: Spotify did not grant {scopes}: reconnect and accept every permission.
settings_music_needs_1: Spotify Premium, on the account that owns the app. A personal app (development mode) admits up to five accounts: add others under User Management.
settings_music_needs_2: The phone must be signed in to the same Spotify account as the one connected here: a browser speaker is only listed for its own account — not for other members of a Family plan, and not found on the network like a smart speaker.
settings_music_needs_3: For the wall to be a speaker, its browser must open DumbMonit over HTTPS (or as localhost on the display itself) and have working DRM (Widevine): Chrome, Edge or Firefox on a computer, Chromium with Widevine on a Raspberry Pi. Most smart-TV and kiosk browsers cannot — the wall says so on screen, and the walls below show it here.
settings_music_needs_4: Browsers keep a page silent until it is touched: tap or press a key on the wall once after it loads (or start the kiosk browser with --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required).
settings_music_needs_5: “Now playing” works without any of that: the server asks Spotify what plays, every few seconds, even over plain HTTP.
settings_music_needs_6: Spotify ends a connection six months after it was approved: connect again before the date shown.
settings_music_nothing_playing: Nothing is playing on this account.
settings_music_nothing_sent: Nothing is sent to the walls. An admin can send a link.
settings_music_outcome_denied: Spotify did not grant access. Start again and choose “Agree”.
settings_music_outcome_exchange: Spotify refused to complete the connection. Check that the redirect URI below is registered in your app, exactly.
settings_music_outcome_hint: Start again below; nothing was changed.
settings_music_outcome_internal: The connection could not be saved. Check the server logs.
settings_music_outcome_state: This approval was unknown, expired or already used. Start again from “Connect Spotify”.
settings_music_reconnect_note: Spotify ends connections after six months.
settings_music_redirect_insecure: DumbMonit is served over plain HTTP, and Spotify only accepts https:// or this 127.0.0.1 address. Nothing answers there: after approving, your browser shows an error page — copy its address, it carries the code. Served over HTTPS, the redirect would be direct.
settings_music_redirect_secure: Spotify comes straight back to this page.
settings_music_step1_after: (any name). Tick Web API and Web Playback SDK, and add this redirect URI:
settings_music_step2_help: On the app's page, under Basic Information. There is no secret to copy: DumbMonit uses PKCE.
settings_music_step3: 3. Approve on Spotify, then come back here.
settings_music_step4_help: It starts with {uri}?code= — valid ten minutes, once.
settings_music_step4_label: 4. Paste the address of the page you landed on
settings_speaker_account_note: — the phone must be signed in to this Spotify account to see the wall.
settings_speaker_err_name: A speaker name is at most 64 characters.
settings_speaker_listed_yes: Yes — phones on this account can pick it
settings_speaker_lists_none: Spotify lists no device on this account right now.
settings_speaker_missing: This server does not report the speaker yet: update DumbMonit.
settings_speaker_name_help: What phones list under Devices. Every wall uses it; add ?speaker=Kitchen to one wall's address to name that one alone. Empty: “DumbMonit Wall”.
settings_speaker_premium_no: No — the wall cannot be a speaker
settings_speaker_premium_unknown: Not known yet (a wall tells when it connects)
settings_speaker_test_hint: Plays the account on “{name}”, resuming what played last.
settings_speaker_test_ok: Spotify now plays on “{name}”: listen to the wall. Nothing to hear? Tap the wall once to unlock its sound.
settings_speaker_walls_none: No wall has reported in the last fifteen minutes. Open /wall on the display (signed in, viewer accounts included) and it shows up here within a minute.
wall_dock_enable_hint: Then pick “{name}” under Devices in Spotify
wall_dock_trouble_title: Spotify can’t play on this display
wall_music_admin_only: Only an admin can change it.
wall_music_link_help: A Spotify, Deezer or YouTube (Music) link to a track, album, playlist or video. Every wall plays it, in the service's own player. Deezer and YouTube have no remote like Spotify Connect: a link is the way.
wall_music_link_label: Play a link on the walls
wall_music_play_error: Spotify did not start playing here.
wall_music_speaker_label: Use this display as a Spotify speaker
wall_music_state_locked_detail: Tap anywhere on the wall once, then pick it in Spotify.
wall_music_state_off_admin: Connect a Spotify account in Settings → Wall music to play from your phone.
wall_music_state_off_user: An admin can connect a Spotify account in Settings → Wall music.
wall_music_state_ready_detail: In Spotify on a phone signed in to the same account: Devices → {name}. Or play here from this panel.
wall_music_state_unlisted_detail: Spotify does not list this display yet; it reconnects by itself in a minute or two.
wall_now_control_failed: Spotify did not answer. Try again.
wall_player_stop_aria: Stop the music on every wall
